Attached: 1 image

You can now give from:@github.com its own group in your Fastmail inbox.

New in Fastmail: Group my mail. Groups put your messages into sections you choose, instead of one long list, newest first. Use search syntax like from:, list: and is:unread, or start with by age, pinned first or unread first.

Open the ⋯ menu at the top of your message list and choose Group. The post covers what groups can and can't match.

https://www.fastmail.com/blog/grouped-mailbox/

#Fastmail #Email #Productivity #BetterEmail
